teaser: You square the folders before the meeting starts, corners flush, though no one has asked you to. That's eleven meeting ISTJ: a life path built for sudden insight, carried by a type built for steady hands. The 11 wants to see further than the room can hold; the ISTJ wants the room itself in order first. Most elevens scatter their vision across moods and midnight notions. You file yours. What comes through you arrives on time, checked twice, already useful to the people standing nearest.
